entries.title: Coral Reef and Cleaning Fish
entries.description: A 3D coral structure with stationary coral polyps and small fish that swim around, attach briefly to “dirty spots” on larger fish to clean them, leaving fading colored specks as “removed parasites” that drift away as particles.

entries.title: Lichen on Rock Time-Lapse
entries.description: A rough, light-colored rock is slowly covered by two interacting organisms: green algae patches and white fungal filaments that grow, wrap, merge, and form composite lichen clusters, with transparency and color shifts indicating successful symbiosis.

entries.title: Clownfish and Sea Anemone Shelter
entries.description: A waving anemone with many semi-transparent tentacles sways in a gentle current while bright clownfish swim in and out, briefly touching tentacles (which flash subtle colors), with predatory fish that bounce away when touching the stinging tentacles.

entries.title: Pollination Partnership: Flower and Bee
